events.title: Commerzbank axes 3,000 jobs in an attempt to fight off UniCredit takeover bid
events.body: Commerzbank wants to cut a further 3,000 jobs and at the same time significantly increase its profit targets. The reorganisation is the bank's response to the takeover ambitions of the major Italian bank UniCredit.View on euronews

events.title: UniCredit Strikes Deal to Sell Part of Russia Business to U.A.E. Investor
